name: upright-lighting-20261031
notes: Upright supervised lighting profile derived from held-upright frames, including the dark-glove condition. The tip range excludes the sleeve false match. The 3 px morphology replay produced 5,684 OK, one partial loss, and zero ambiguous frames over 5,685 historical frames. Tip minimum area was reduced from 35 to 20 px after live raw frames intermittently eroded the clear roughly 90 px tip blob below the prior threshold.
